topic: How stock market circuit breakers work

sources.claim: Market-wide circuit breakers trigger at 7%, 13%, 20% declines in S&P 500 vs prior close
sources.source: NYSE Market-Wide Circuit Breakers FAQ; Investor.gov glossary

sources.claim: Level 1/2 halt trading minimum 15 minutes if triggered between 9:30am-3:25pm; Level 3 halts for the rest of the day at any time
SEC approved changing thresholds from 10/20/30% (DJIA-based) to 7/13/20% (S&P 500-based), effective Feb 4, 2013
sources.source: SEC rule filing history, reported via NASDAQ Trader circuit breaker page

pronunciation_notes.note: said as 'S and P five hundred'
